summary: Air exercise with two aircraft including fast jets performing high energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of Ingleby Greenhow, up to 17,500 feet.
text:
AIR EXER. 2 ACFT INCLUDING FAST JET WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY
MANOEUVRES IN SUPPORT OF GROUND OPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 
542622N 0010642W (INGLEBY GREENHOW). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF 
UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER
INFO AIC Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC FREQ 271.400MHZ. FOR INFO
07972 787428. AR-2026-11281/01.
